aim.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.done: You did what you set out to do. Folk will call you %s now.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.broken: You let it go. Word gets about of how you left it.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cheer.0: So you are %s now. Well done, I say.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cheer.1: %s, they will say of you. It suits you.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.kind.0: I heard how you left it. I will not hold it against you for ever.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.kind.1: Everyone falters. Come now, do better next time.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.cold.0: I know what you did, and what you did not. Do not expect much of us.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.cold.1: You gave your word and walked off. I remember.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.plain.0: They say you turned your back on it. Is that so?
aim.jaymoskingdoms.scorn.plain.1: I heard how it went with you. A pity.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.city.page: Earn the good name of this city. People should say my name without a frown.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.city.title: the Respected
aim.jaymoskingdoms.village.page: Be someone this village is glad to have. Do right by them until they say so.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.village.title: Friend of the Village
aim.jaymoskingdoms.sworn.page: Rise from recruit to knight in the realm I swore to.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.sworn.title: the Sworn Knight
aim.jaymoskingdoms.banished.page: Win my way back. One day they will let me through the gate again.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.banished.title: the Returned
aim.jaymoskingdoms.wild.page: Find people and put down roots. Join a settlement, or start one.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.wild.title: the Settler
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cave.page: Clear out the spiders. Fifteen of them, and then I will sleep easy.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cave.title: Spiderbane
aim.jaymoskingdoms.shipwreck.page: Stay alive ten days on this shore, and then see what comes.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.shipwreck.title: the Castaway
aim.jaymoskingdoms.monolith.page: Hunt down the creatures that come out at night. Twenty-five will do.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.monolith.title: the Night Hunter
aim.jaymoskingdoms.skyfall.page: Find people. I have fallen a long way, and I want a place among them.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.skyfall.title: the Newcomer
aim.jaymoskingdoms.timelost.page: Last ten days in a time that is not mine, and I will manage the rest.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.timelost.title: the Stranded
aim.jaymoskingdoms.burned.page: Make a home again. A bed or a trade, three days running, and I am back on my feet.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.burned.title: Risen from Ash
aim.jaymoskingdoms.snowed.page: Get warm and stay warm. A bed or a trade, three days in a place with a fire.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.snowed.title: the Thawed
aim.jaymoskingdoms.captive.page: Cut three people free of their ropes, as I was cut free.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.captive.title: the Rescuer
aim.jaymoskingdoms.whalers.page: Take a whale. One, with my own hand on the iron.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.whalers.title: the Harpooner
aim.jaymoskingdoms.unarmed.page: Show them I am not helpless. Ten monsters, short as I am.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.unarmed.title: the Unbowed
aim.jaymoskingdoms.chained.page: Free five of the others in the camp. Nobody stays in chains if I can help it.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.chained.title: the Liberator
aim.jaymoskingdoms.rock_bottom.page: Get up. A bed or a trade, three days, and I am no longer at the bottom.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.rock_bottom.title: Back on Their Feet
aim.jaymoskingdoms.sentenced.page: Do my time and then make a life in this city. A bed or a trade for three days.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.sentenced.title: the Reformed
aim.jaymoskingdoms.evicted.page: Get a roof back. A bed in this city, or a trade, for three days.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.evicted.title: Home Again
aim.jaymoskingdoms.hideout.page: Go straight. I want the folk of this town to stop looking at me like that.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.hideout.title: the Straightened
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cast_out.page: Find people who will have me. Join a settlement, or start one.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.cast_out.title: the Welcomed
aim.jaymoskingdoms.heirloom.page: Keep the blade. If someone comes for it, they will not leave with it. Ten days, at the least.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.heirloom.title: the Blade-Bearer
aim.jaymoskingdoms.trader.page: Get five orders delivered. A trader is only as good as the goods he gets there.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.trader.title: the Trader
aim.jaymoskingdoms.pup.page: Raise this pup right, until it is grown and still at my heel.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.pup.title: Wolf-Friend
aim.jaymoskingdoms.nobodies.page: Look after the three who came with me. Seven days, all of us alive.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.nobodies.title: the Band-Leader
aim.jaymoskingdoms.moon.page: Last ten days up here. Breathe, and keep moving.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.moon.title: the Moonwalker
aim.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.page: Find people in this green place and make a home among them.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.title: the Greenwalker
aim.jaymoskingdoms.rustfall.page: Last ten days under all this weight, and I will be harder for it.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.rustfall.title: Rust-Hardened
aim.jaymoskingdoms.maw.page: Last seven days in the maw. Do not stop.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.maw.title: the Maw-Walker
aim.jaymoskingdoms.demon.page: Last ten days down here, and keep my head.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.demon.title: the Hell-Wise
aim.jaymoskingdoms.afterlife.page: Last seven days, and find my way back among the living.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.afterlife.title: the Twice-Born
aim.jaymoskingdoms.page.alt: Stay alive ten days, and then see what comes.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.lost: One of your three is gone, and with it what you meant to do.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.lab.page: Get far from that room, and find a place that takes me in.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.lab.title: the Unbottled
aim.jaymoskingdoms.android.page: Prove the build: put down fifteen that come for me.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.android.title: the Proven
aim.jaymoskingdoms.moon_cursed.page: Last ten days with this mark on me.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.moon_cursed.title: the Moonmarked
aim.jaymoskingdoms.greenskin.page: Make a human town take me for a person, not a thing from the camps. Earn a good name with them.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.greenskin.title: the Accepted
